jobs_results.title: Back-End Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for an experienced software developer to bring to market a creative performance tool.

Incubated at the heart of Stagwell, SmartAssets is designed to address the needs of brands and marketing agencies by providing them with a solution to optimise their creative production process, ultimately reducing waste and enhancing overall effectiveness, blending creative and performance into one single engine.

As a key member of the development team, you will work closely with the CTO, to spearhead the creation of the End-to-End infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of the SmartAssets platform. Your primary responsibility will be to design, develop and implement the robust and scalable infrastructure required to support the tool’s functionalities.

This is a great opportunity to work with us because we will be developing:
• Innovative Product: You will be part of bringing to market SmartAssets, a creative performance tool that blends creative and performance into one... powerful engine. By joining our team, you will contribute to addressing the needs of brands and marketing agencies, helping them optimize their creative production process and achieve greater effectiveness
• Industry Impact: SmartAssets is incubated at Stagwell, a leading organization in the marketing industry. Working on this project means being at the forefront of cutting-edge solutions that can revolutionize how creatives are produced and enhance overall marketing strategies. You will have the chance to make a significant impact in the industry
• End-to-End Infrastructure: As a key member of the development team, you will have a central role in designing and implementing the robust and scalable infrastructure that powers the SmartAssets platform. This opportunity will allow you to showcase your skills and expertise in developing complex software systems
• Collaboration with CTO: You will work directly with the Chief Technology Officer, gaining valuable insights and guidance from an experienced professional in the field. This collaboration offers an excellent learning opportunity and a chance to contribute to the strategic decisions that shape the development of the platform
• Growth and Learning: By working on SmartAssets, you will have the opportunity to expand your knowledge and stay updated with the latest advancements in software development and performance optimization. You will work with a diverse team of experts, enabling personal and professional growth in a dynamic and challenging environment
• Positive Impact: By reducing waste and increasing effectiveness in creative production, SmartAssets contributes to sustainability and efficiency in marketing practices. As part of our team, you will be involved in creating a positive impact by enabling brands and marketing agencies to achieve their goals more efficiently. This opportunity offers a chance to work on an innovative product, collaborate with industry leaders, showcase your skills in developing infrastructure and make a positive impact in the marketing industry

About the role:

Design and implement an End-to-End infrastructure native on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), as well as the implementation of the components for the E2E infrastructure (Lambda, S3, EC2, Cognito, amongst others). Maintain a thorough documentation of the system as well as implement the best practices.

Requirements
• Familiarity with the CI / CD processes, GitHub, Jenkins (or similar), Jira
• Good understanding of Agile development methodologies
• Degree in Computer Science

Experience:
• Java (Spring Framework) - 2 years
• NoSQL (MongoDB)

Nice to haves:

Although your main focus will be in backend Java development being a startup we have plenty of opportunities to get involved in work involving other technologies depending on your experience / preferences, experience in the following would be a plus
• Python
• Building ML pipelines / Distributed job processing experience
• Front End experience (React / SPA's)

Benefits

In return for your enthusiasm and expertise, we can offer an exciting and multicultural place of work, competitive salary, wide range of benefits, and the chance to progress your career.

Some Of These Incredible Benefits Include
• Holiday: You will get 24 days holiday per year (pro-rata in first year). This entitlement will increase by a further one day for each completed year of service up to a maximum of 30 days after six years’ service
• Flexible Working: Opportunities to work from home up to 3 days a week through our Flexible Working Policy, plus opportunities to work abroad
• Refer a Friend Scheme: We’re always on the lookout for talented people. If you refer a friend who is then hired, we will award you with a bonus depending on the level of the role being recruited for
• Birthday Day Off: As a gift from us you will receive an extra day off for your birthday each year. If your birthday falls on a weekend, then you can take this the Friday before or Monday after
• Rest and Recharge: The option to lengthen your standard 1 hour lunch break by 30 minutes, as long as you maintain the same number of hours you work a day

jobs_results.title: Back Developer
jobs_results.description:
Quiénes somos Desde hace 15 años desarrollamos software para grandes empresas. El proyecto backend más grande que tenemos es para una empresa de retail puntera. Durante los últimos años, hemos trabajado en una migración de sus servidores web basando la nueva infraestructura en microservicios.

Qué buscamos Buscamos desarrolladores de Backend con experiencia profesional con el lenguaje Java, dado que nuestro equipo está desarrollando parte del servidor en Java, haciendo análisis técnicos y participando en la definición de la arquitectura del Backend.
Este proyecto supone un reto continuo de autosuperación y aprendizaje constante.

Valoramos que hayas trabajado en proyectos en los que la organización y trabajo en equipo sean esenciales, ya que la dinámica que tenemos aquí sigue estas líneas.
Nos importan tanto los conocimientos técnicos que hayas consolidado, así como tus soft skills.

Qué hacemos Creamos la lógica de los microservicios de backend de una gran web (30M de usuarios... activos diarios y puntos de venta en todo el mundo) Trabajamos con bases de datos y nos comunicamos con colas / otros microservicios.
Participamos democráticamente en la definición de arquitectura del Backend. Buenos análisis de los requisitos funcionales. Elaboración de propuestas técnicas. Planteamiento de nuevas funcionalidades. Desarrollamos software con Java, Spring, CouchBase, JPA, JUnit, Tomcat, Jetty, SQL, MongoDB, CouchBase, Maven y Git. Valoramos el conocimiento de Java enterprise (JEE), JMS, ORM y Websphere commerce. Qué ofrecemos Horario de trabajo flexible Desarrollo interno a través de workshops Asistencia a eventos y conferencias internacionales Teletrabajo semanal Salario competitivo Fruta dos veces por semana Snacks semanales gratuitos 25 días de vacaciones anuales Muy buen entorno de trabajo Vermouth algunos viernes, torneos de pádel, karts, excursiones, cenas, BirrAfterwork UNCODE.initRow(document.getElementById("script-537533")); #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador /a Back-End
jobs_results.description:
Sobre el puesto:

Buscamos un profesional con 3 años de experiencia laboral como Desarrollador /a Back-end para participar en proyectos de desarrollo.

Sobre Orizon:

Orizon lleva 15 años en el mercado ofreciendo soluciones de rendimiento tecnológico que aportan valor a compañías del IBEX35 y grandes empresas líderes de sus sectores, identificando y resolviendo problemas del software para asegurar niveles máximos de disponibilidad, rendimiento y eficiencia. El impacto del ahorro económico y el aumento de la velocidad de las aplicaciones es relevante para las organizaciones con las que Orizon trabaja, convirtiéndose en aliado clave del cuadro directivo. Pionera en la utilización de Inteligencia artificial aplicada a la mejora del negocio en entornos de producción informática (AIOps), Orizon monitoriza, detecta y resuelve ineficiencias en el 100% de los elementos tecnológicos. Su I+D+i y su tecnología, única en el mercado, está reconocida por instituciones oficiales españolas y por la... Comisión Europea.

Descripción del puesto:

Tus tareas se centrarán en la participación activa en la planificación, diseño, desarrollo del proyecto, además de evolucionar la arquitectura.

Competencias:

Nivel de Conocimientos y Experiencia:
• Experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones con Java (11+) utilizando frameworks de Spring (Spring Boot, Spring Batch) y Maven.
• Experiencia en el desarrollo de proyectos mediante metodologías ágiles.
• Experiencia en bases de datos relacionales.
• Experiencia con tests unitarios y tests de integración.
• Experiencia en el diagnóstico y resolución de problemas de rendimiento en sistemas complejos.
• Experiencia distintos protocolos de comunicación (REST, gRPC, eventos, messaging).
• Capacidad de diseñar y documentar decisiones de arquitectura.
• Capacidad de investigar nuevas tecnologías/frameworks/librerías y saber integrarlas según las necesidades.
• Capacidad de proporcionar ayuda técnica a los desarrolladores más juniors.

Valorable:
• Conocimientos en tecnologías de colas (Kafka, RabbitMQ…), Docker y entornos Linux.
• Control de servicios AWS
• Conocimiento de kubernetes.
• Habilidades en arquitecturas de microservicios.
• Control de integración continua CI/CD.
• Conocimientos de keycloak.

Qué ofrecemos:
• Salario competitivo en función de tus conocimientos y desempeño.
• Contrato estable.
• Jornada laboral flexible. Te ofrecemos una modalidad de trabajo flexible y adaptado a tu día a día, presencial, remoto o mixto.
• Formación personalizada a cargo de la empresa y de acuerdo a tus necesidades.
• Clases de Inglés a cargo de la empresa.
• Te proporcionamos el equipo de trabajo que tu elijas.
• Jornada reducida en verano
• Formar parte de una compañía consolidada y en crecimiento, con una cultura de trabajo positiva y colaborativa y donde las personas que la integran son su mayor activo.

En Orizon creemos en las personas, en el esfuerzo y en la superación. Nuestro objetivo es crear equipos de personas y potenciar su talento. Respetamos la diversidad y apoyamos una cultura inclusiva.

Envíanos tu CV:

rrhh@orizon.es

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Java developer Job Offer We are looking for a Java developer to join our software development team ! We build goal-driven working software and we want essential people to be part of our growing team and to work with us on inspiring projects.

Who we are?

At Apiumhub, we are experts in software architecture and software development. We build scalable software platforms and think about performance and cost reduction every time we start the project. We receive interesting projects from around the world, as startups projects as projects for big international companies. But what we always do the same – we build working software. And we want like-minded people to join us!

Meet our growing family!

What are the requirements?

Qualifications:

Bachelor Degree in computer science, software engineering or similar5+ years of backend development experience

Experience in Java Experience in Spring Boot Experience in Continuous Integration

Experience working with Docker

Experience with... DDDDevOps knowledge

Agile Methodologies Experience in Test Driven Development and unit testing

Strong knowledge of SOLID principles

Strong knowledge in object-oriented programming concepts (polymorphism, interface segregation, encapsulation, topology, etc)
Understanding of refactoring concepts

Knowledge of the main and the most used design patterns

Be experienced in working on Linux Fluent speaking Spanish Desired skills:

Experience in Kotlin Know how to work with CI & TDD Functional coding experience

Experience with gRPCFluent in English

Responsibilities Opportunity to work on various types of projects from different industries (possibility to work remotely 100%)Team empowerment

Apply best practices in software development

Work with strict Agile methodologies

Work with TDD & CIDo refactoring to a DDD architecture

Learn more about Software Architecture and Dev Ops Develop complex software projects with an eye on performance, scalability, and reusability

Benefits

Permanent contract and 23 days of vacation.

Remote friendly policy, be the owner of your time and enjoy the flexibility and remote working. We have an amazing new office in the Barcelona center (with free snacks, coffee and beer), and we will be very happy to share moments with you there whenever you want.

Medical insurance with dental coverage.

Free English classes.

Personal budget for continuous learning, training and certifications.

Team budget just for fun.

You will enjoy different activities, from technical and informal workshops to off site company events.

Last but not least, join a growing family with a great sense of humor and healthy environment.

Process
30-40minuts introduction meeting to talk about what we can offer you, and know a little bit about you, your experience and your goals.
1h technical meeting. No-code meeting, just technical discussions.
30 minutes cultural fit meeting.

At Apiumhub we value profiles without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status or any other ground or circumstances protected by federal, state or local law

jobs_results.title: Senior Game Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
About Us

Sandsoft was formed by industry leaders from international video games publishers and local talent with the core ambition to help develop the gaming ecosystem across MENA, modernise the region and to take MENA from an emerging market to a global market leader. Sandsoft has offices in Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates and China and also offers work from home opportunities. Sandsoft is looking for talented individuals who share the same drive and vision. With rapid growth plans the team are recruiting for a number of roles.

Our team is working with two internal and several external game development studios to create engaging mobile first games for the wide audience. Modern games are not living entirely on the mobile devices, but use backend platforms to enable interactive systems and features, such as matchmaking, leaderboards, live events, season passes and more.

As a member of the central Sandsoft Tech function you will be working with multiple studios helping them to... build gameplay systems to engage with players, track their progress, creating features such as stores, crafting, inventories and many more.

What you will do:
• Share your deep expertise in game backends with multiple development teams, empowering them to build compelling game features.
• Develop game architectures using PlayFab or similar platforms, AWS or Azure resources to ensure seamless integration and performance.
• Construct gameplay systems and features like leaderboards, live events, season pass, level progression, crafting, shops, and in-app purchases.
• Implement robust backend validation mechanisms to safeguard game logic and prevent cheating or exploits.
• Craft detailed technical specifications, design documents, and collaborate with designers to ensure technical feasibility.
• Contribute clean, maintainable client-side and backend code, utilizing Unity and PlayFab Blueprints.
• Plan, research, and architect new services based on stakeholder priorities.
• Mentor team members, conduct technical interviews, and take ownership of specific gameplay systems and features.

What you will bring:
• 5+ years of experience in gaming software engineering, specializing in PlayFab and related frameworks.
• Expertise in PlayFab or similar game management platforms.
• Experience with Azure functions, SignalR, Redis, AWS, DataDog, Kibana, Jenkins, GitHub actions is a big plus.
• Proven experience with serverless game backend architecture.
• Familiarity with Unity development and testing automation frameworks.
• Demonstrated ability to lead feature development from inception to completion, including requirements gathering, design documentation, implementation, testing, and monitoring.
• Exceptional organizational, follow-through, and quality-assurance skills.
• A positive, collaborative, and professional demeanor.

Bonus Experience
• Multiplayer game development experience, including dedicated servers, replication, and client prediction.

What do we offer:
• Private medical health insurance for you and your family
• Central office location
• Free gym access
• Regular team-building activities: lots of team fun including company offsite in our headquarter in Riyadh, KSA
• Career growth opportunities: you will grow as we grow!
• Fun and supportive working environment

At Sandsoft, we do things differently.

We pride ourselves in hiring growth-minded people who show a motivated, collaborative, and entrepreneurial attitude, and who embrace our Core Values as the right way to develop something great together.

Sandsoft core values are:

Boldness 👩🚀 + Togetherness🤝 + Growth 🚀

To know more about Sandsoft, visit our website or Linkedin profile.

If you feel like you would like to be part of this journey, we encourage you to apply

• Craft detailed technical specifications, design documents, and collaborate with designers to ensure technical feasibility.
• Contribute clean, maintainable client-side and backend code, utilizing Unity and PlayFab Blueprints.
• Plan, research, and architect new services based on stakeholder priorities.
• Mentor team members, conduct technical interviews, and take ownership of specific gameplay systems and features.

What you will bring:
• 5+ years of experience in gaming software engineering, specializing in PlayFab and related frameworks.
• Expertise in PlayFab or similar game management platforms.
• Experience with Azure functions, SignalR, Redis, AWS, DataDog, Kibana, Jenkins, GitHub actions is a big plus.
• Proven experience with serverless game backend architecture.
• Familiarity with Unity development and testing automation frameworks.
• Demonstrated ability to lead feature development from inception to completion, including requirements gathering, design documentation, implementation, testing, and monitoring.
• Exceptional organizational, follow-through, and quality-assurance skills.
• A positive, collaborative, and professional demeanor.

Bonus Experience
• Multiplayer game development experience, including dedicated servers, replication, and client prediction.

What do we offer:
• Private medical health insurance for you and your family
• Central office location
• Free gym access
• Regular team-building activities: lots of team fun including company offsite in our headquarter in Riyadh, KSA
• Career growth opportunities: you will grow as we grow!
• Fun and supportive working environment

At Sandsoft, we do things differently.

We pride ourselves in hiring growth-minded people who show a motivated, collaborative, and entrepreneurial attitude, and who embrace our Core Values as the right way to develop something great together.

Sandsoft core values are:

Boldness 👩🚀 + Togetherness🤝 + Growth 🚀

To know more about Sandsoft, visit our website or Linkedin profile.

If you feel like you would like to be part of this journey, we encourage you to apply

jobs_results.title: Staff Backend Engineer (Java) - 23424
jobs_results.description:
Description

Why YOU want this position

Enverus has expanded its solutions in Power & Renewables with the addition of RatedPower. A high growth start-up, RatedPower’s technology expands our portfolio of solutions in solar with its cloud-based software that automates and optimizes the feasibility study, analysis, design and engineering of solar power plants, and our geographical coverage internationally.

Enverus is the leading energy SaaS company delivering highly technical insights and predictive/prescriptive analytics that empower customers to make decisions that increase profit. Enverus’ innovative technologies drive production and investment strategies, enable best practices for energy and commodity trading and risk management, and reduce costs through automated processes across critical business functions. Enverus is a strategic partner to more than 6,000 customers in 50 countries.

We are currently seeking a Backend – Staff to join our Engineering team based in Madrid. This... role offers the opportunity to join a rapidly growing company delivering industry-leading solutions to customers in the world’s most dynamic and fastest-growing sector.

What You’ll Do
• Contribute to architectural design and decisions.
• Improve our product by developing new or improving functionalities, with efficient, reusable, and easy to maintain code.
• Collaborate with Product, Design and Backend teams, to frame and tackle the challenges, both from a technical and business context.
• Manage and improve CI procedures.
• Administrate and maintain cloud infrastructure with guidance from our devSecOps engineers.
• Identify and implement improvements that reduce technical debt and enable the team to iterate faster.
• Identifying and addressing performance and scalability issues.
• Reaches beyond immediate needs considering the longer-term, and is always looking beyond for ways to have a broad impact.
• Able to take ownership on complex requirements and decompose them into a proposal of small deliverables.
• Leverage feedback to drive the best possible outcomes with the information that is available.
• Help others to improve their technical skills
• Become the go-to person and be the mentor for other engineers inside outside the team

What You Should Have
• 5+ year in Java, and object-oriented development
• Extensive knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, Postgress)
• Knowledge of non-relational databases (mongoDB)
• Deep understanding of architectural principle, common design principles, patterns, and best practices.
• Good experience writing unitary tests.
• Strong motivation to drive impact by making product improvements and by suggesting and implementing technical enhancements.
• Proactiveness, thinking out of the box, team player and willingness to teach & learn from peer.
• Experience with performance and optimization problems and a demonstrated ability to both diagnose and prevent these problems
• Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
• Comfort working in a highly agile, intensely iterative software development process.
• Proactiveness, team player and willingness to teach & learn from peers
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

Our Technology Stack

Java, Spring Boot, Docker, MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, AWS (multiple services), RabbitMQ, Redis, Grafana, QuickSight, Github Actions, Travis, Jira, Confluence

What We Offer
• Work on a unique product where you can see the result of your work materialize in every new release.
• Allow your inspirational ideas to come to life in a highly creative and execution environment.
• The opportunity to challenge in a high-performing organization and leave each day knowing you have made an impact.
• You choose: position fully remote (based in Spain) or hybrid working model (able to combine working from home and from our office in Madrid city center).
• Great teamwork working side by side with an incredibly talented workforce willing to share its knowledge and expertise.
• Career development according to your aspirations and interests. We support our employees with continuous training. You'll get to work together with your manager on defining your career path (focused on technology, team management, and many other possibilities).
• Opportunity to develop yourself and to be part of a fast-growing startup. You’ll have a direct impact on our way of working and decisions made in the business.
• Compensation commensurate with experience.
• Health insurance, meals/transportation and other benefits.
• Work-life balance and Diversity and Inclusion initiatives. We work with humans. Happy humans.
• Your work will be meaningful and have a direct impact on the planet. Together we shape the future of renewables

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer - O11y, Asserts (Remote, Spain)
jobs_results.description:
This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in Spain only.

What do we do?

The Asserts.ai team joined Grafana Labs as part of an acquisition and is now growing inside the larger Observability group. The backend team is responsible for building and operating a set of low-latency microservices built in Java and databases like Graph DB. The services provide automated Root Cause Insights by actively querying the Grafana Cloud Metrics, Traces, and Logs databases and integrating with the Grafana platform components like Dashboarding and Alerting. The Asserts services are multi-tenant, highly available and process and store data in Graph and Timeseries DB. We will soon be rolling it out to thousands of self-service customers, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it all more efficiently.

Grafana is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and... diverse perspectives. Every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.

Requirements
• You have solid Java programming experience. Asserts services are built on Java. All our core databases are built on Go.
• You have worked on a big SaaS platform and dealt with common distributed systems problems (e.g., scalability, multi-tenancy, data isolation, HA, …)
• You have used K8s or a public Cloud for operating your software and were responsible for operating the software you have built.
• You are passionate about writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
• You have prior experience in owning customers' experience by participating in weekday 12h x 5d and separate weekend 24h x 2d on-call rotations.
• Collaboration and communication: As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is mainly remote, good communication skills, ability to work independently and collaborate with distributed teams is a must.

Nice To Haves
• Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects)
• Familiarity with GoLang

What will you be doing?
• Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers.
• Take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively
• Maintain critical systems, and own their reliability, performance, and availability.
• Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running.
• Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions, and collaborate with the team
• Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase.

In Spain, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 88,627 - EUR 106,353. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
• Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

About Grafana Labs: There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).

Benefits: For more information about the perks and benefits of working at Grafana, please check out our careers page.

Equal Opportunity Employer: At Grafana Labs we’re building a company where a diverse mix of talented people want to come, stay, and do their best work. We know that our company runs on the hard work and the dedication of our passionate and creative employees. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.

We will recruit, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, disability, age, veteran status, and all the other fascinating characteristics that make us different and unique. We believe that equality and diversity builds a strong organization and we’re working hard to make sure that’s the foundation of our organization as we grow.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy

jobs_results.description:
¡Hola!

Somos CAPGEMINI, una compañía TOP EMPLOYER con 360.000 PERSONAS en todo el mundo unidas por una misma pasión: liderar la evolución hacia un futuro sostenible e inclusivo a través de la TECNOLOGÍA.

Estamos emocionados de anunciar una oportunidad para un/a profesional altamente calificado/a en el sector de la tecnología. Actualmente, estamos desarrollando un proyecto de gran envergadura con el objetivo de transformar la industria. Estamos en busca de un/a apasionado/a por la tecnología que quiera formar parte de este emocionante proyecto.

La persona en este rol tendrá la misión de:
• Desarrollar soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas utilizando su experiencia en Salesforce Commerce y SFRA.
• Colaborar estrechamente con un equipo multidisciplinario para garantizar el éxito del proyecto.
• Implementar las mejores prácticas de desarrollo, incluyendo control de versiones con Git y herramientas de integración continua.
• Contribuir activamente a la metodología Agile para una entrega... eficiente y de alta calidad.
• Aportar su experiencia previa como programador (más de 2 años) en lenguajes orientados a objetos o frameworks.
• Utilizar su nivel medio-alto de inglés tanto hablado como escrito para colaborar en un entorno internacional.
• Liderar la implementación de integraciones con otros sistemas y demostrar un profundo conocimiento de las APIs estándar de Salesforce.
• Participar activamente en el ciclo de vida del proyecto, incluyendo la gestión y realización de revisiones de diseño y código.
• Trabajar de manera efectiva en un entorno de entrega basado en equipos utilizando la metodología Agile Scrum.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia a partir de 2 años en desarrollo de Salesforce Commerce, con experiencia en SFRA.
• Conocimiento sólido de Git y herramientas de integración continua, incluyendo la implementación.
• Experiencia en metodologías Agile.
• Más de 2 años de experiencia como programador en lenguajes orientados a objetos o frameworks.
• Nivel medio-alto de inglés, tanto hablado como escrito.
• Experiencia exitosa en la implementación de integraciones con otros sistemas y profundo conocimiento de las APIs estándar de Salesforce.
• Familiaridad con el ciclo de vida del proyecto.
• Experiencia en la gestión y realización de revisiones de diseño y código.
• Habilidad para trabajar en un entorno de entrega basado en equipos utilizando la metodología Agile/Scrum.
• Deseable experiencia en Mirakl.

Valoramos todas las candidaturas y te ofrecemos un entorno de trabajo estimulante y en constante crecimiento. En Capgemini, nos enorgullece ofrecer una amplia gama de oportunidades de desarrollo y formación, incluyendo certificaciones y cursos presenciales y en línea. ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

¿Sabes todo lo que podemos ofrecerte?
• Tipo de Contrato: Contrato indefinido.
• FORMACIÓN continua y certificaciones con Partners oficiales.
• Acceso a TELETRABAJO nacional (80%) e internacional (FlexAbroad con hasta 45 días al año).
• Acceso a oficinas con ENTORNOS COLABORATIVOS en espacios multifuncionales.
• Compromiso con la DIVERSIDAD y la ÉTICA, certificados durante más de 11 años consecutivos.
• FLEXIBILIDAD, CONCILIACIÓN y BENEFICIOS fiscales y sociales para tu vida personal y profesional.
• Sistema de RETRIBUCIÓN FLEXIBLE.
• DESCUENTOS y promociones a través de nuestro Club Capgemini (deportes, viajes, ...).

¿Nos vemos y te contamos con más detalle
